_comment: Ranking weights and cross-team milestones, vendored from the pre-rebuild seed (main @ f5dce59). build_import.py reads these from here rather than from the seed-data.json it also writes, so they have a source of record that cannot be lost by a bad run.

milestones.title: Registration MVP ships (early Aug '26)
milestones.description: First modern registration MVP reaches camps ahead of the mid-September GA target.

milestones.title: UltraCamp on new payment processor (mid-Aug '26)
milestones.description: All UltraCamp customers migrated to the new Paysafe + Rainforest payment processor.

milestones.title: Registration + Payments GA — ready for Summer '27
milestones.description: Registration and Payments reach GA ahead of Summer '27 enrollment.

milestones.title: Summer '27 enrollment opens on modern registration
milestones.description: First enrollment cycle opens on the modern registration flow.

milestones.title: First in-season use of modern staff / medical / attendance
milestones.description: Modern staff, medical, and attendance tools used in-season for the first time.

milestones.title: First cohort flips to the modern platform
milestones.description: Wave 1 design partners cut over. Waves run Sept–Feb only; March–August is an in-season blackout.

milestones.title: 2nd enrollment cycle fully modern (Summer '28)
milestones.description: The second enrollment cycle runs fully on the modern platform.

milestones.title: ✦ Modernization complete — feature parity on the modern platform (~Apr 2028)
milestones.description: Feature parity reached on the modern platform. Not a retirement date: camps still have to be migrated onto it, which runs about another year (see ms-monolith-retired).

milestones.title: First full season entirely on the modern platform
milestones.description: The first full summer season runs entirely on the modern platform.

milestones.title: Legacy monolith decommissioned
milestones.description: The last camp is off the legacy platform and it is switched off — about a year after feature parity, once the Sept–Feb migration windows allow it.
